messages:
tess (pm): Heads-up: BetaCorp says they need data-residency (EU-only tenancy) in MVP or they won't sign the pilot. They asked if we can move it up. Thoughts?
omar (eng): Data residency is non-trivial: separate DB schemas + infra routing + config for tenants. Realistic timeline is 4-5 weeks of focused work.
rita (product): If we can't deliver EU residency in MVP, can we offer a v1 commitment with a guaranteed kickoff date? Sales will need that for the contract.
kai (security): Also need to think about encryption key separation and audit scope. If we promise residency we must scope HSM/KMS involvement and add one SOC checklist item. That's another week.
noah (sales): BetaCorp is firm on pilot timing. They'll accept a "staged residency" approach if we can: 1) EU data in isolated storage (not fully locked-down) for pilot, 2) full residency in v1 within 6 weeks. They want the staged plan in writing.
tess (pm): Staged residency might be doable. Two options: X) Prioritize residency for BetaCorp into MVP and push noncritical analytics to v1. Y) Keep current MVP, promise staged residency (isolated storage + SLA) and do full residency early v1. Which keeps launch on track?
omar (eng): Option X would push MVP by ~2 weeks because of infra churn. Option Y keeps MVP date but requires a documented cut: what exactly is "isolated storage" vs full residency. We need acceptance criteria.
kai (security): For staged: acceptance criteria should include: EU-region data stored in EU-only buckets, separate encryption keys, and dedicated access controls for BetaCorp. Full residency (v1) adds formal auditing and KMS HSM separation.
rita (product): Let's draft minimal acceptance criteria for the staged approach and update milestone tracker. If BetaCorp agrees to staged plus signed SLA, we keep MVP.
noah (sales): I'll ask BetaCorp if staged satisfies their legal/ops. They asked for a written timeline. Need a decision by EOD.
ops-bot: Reminder: feature-freeze window starts in 9 days.
tess (pm): Proposed immediate actions: 1) omar + kai write the staged-residency checklist (TA, KMS scope, infra mapping) by EOD; 2) rita draft the SLA language; 3) noah to confirm with BetaCorp. If BetaCorp rejects staged, we escalate Option X to execs.
omar (eng): I'll start the checklist and flag any blockers.
kai (security): Will outline the KMS/HSM requirements and audit touches.
rita (product): Drafting SLA now, will include milestone targets: MVP launch stays 2026-04-15, staged residency available day-0 for BetaCorp, full residency v1 kickoff 2026-05-20 with delivery by 2026-06-30.	ess (pm): Marking this thread as 'scope-decision: staged-residency' in the milestone doc. If BetaCorp signs staged SLA, no timeline reset. If they decline, call for emergency scope meeting.
noah (sales): I'll update when I hear back. Target to get BetaCorp reply before 17:00 PT.
ops-bot: NOTE: production deployment blackout tomorrow 08:00-09:00 UTC.
tess (pm): Thanks team. We'll reconvene if BetaCorp pushes back.
